title: The creative-project garden got three new blooms
summary:
A community-directory day: eight new projects across creative, builder, chat, and learning corners, plus a sturdier chat sanitizer.

The community showcase now features the Pollinations AI Demo, Mixbash.com, StoryWeaver AI, and ☬ SHΞNΞRATOR—four more examples of people turning simple AI endpoints into strange and useful things.

Pollinations OpenAI Proxy and unpkg.ai joined the Hack-and-Build collection, giving developers two more reference points for putting AI infrastructure to work without making a small consultancy out of it.

チャットGPT 日本語 was added to Chat Projects and EduGen AI to Learn, making the community catalog a little more useful for Japanese-language chat and education-focused experiments.
